name: Vésztő (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over green, charged at the centre with the town arms of Vésztő: a crowned blue and yellow shield with white ploughshares, a star and a crescent, with red and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Vésztő arms with crown and mantling
